column1: # Every line is "topic<TAB>title". The title must be the canonical English
# Wikipedia article title, not a redirect: a run detects arrival by comparing
# titles, so a redirect target can never be reached. tools/verify_titles.py
# checks this against the Wikipedia API and the build refuses a list that
# fails, so add freely and let the check tell you the canonical form.
# Topics must be one of the keys in TOPICS in tools/build_dataset.py.
# An optional third column is a weight: how many times more likely this article
# is to be picked as a start or a target than a plain entry. Leave it off for 1.
